name: Charlie Bennett
review: Optometry needed vision evidence that is absent. Keep the supported social-research degree alternative visible outside Top three; this is not a model with no degree option.

name: Cameron Jones
review: Removing Animal Scientist is justified: animal care is not farm-animal production research. Circuit/design/testing interest remains genuine. Electronics Engineers has two defining domains and an unknown safety responsibility. A scoped safety follow-up is sensible; the current shared safety item does not include this career in its routing list.

name: Alexis Reed
review: Vision interest is unrecorded. Personal care, cooking and carpentry remain supported. Education interests warrant a classroom/assessment distinction, not replacement with an unrelated medical profession.

name: Cameron Singh
review: Animal behavior/care and research willingness are real, but farm production is unstated. Do not restore Animal Scientist. Explore observational animal behavior and care before deciding whether a professional research or clinical route fits; health is explicitly disliked.

name: Blair Singh
review: Vision interest is unrecorded. Paralegal remains supported and aligns with written rules/arguments. Other finance or compliance routes need their own quantitative, leadership or accountability evidence.

name: Jamie Walker
review: Removing Animal Scientist is justified. Food comparison/testing/research remains a plausible path with one activity domain; precision/records interest is unknown. Technical design and safety interests are also unresolved. No automatic replacement Top is justified.
